templates.title: Salary Certificate Affidavit
templates.body: I hereby declare that the salary information furnished by me is true and correct.

templates.title: Passport Loss Affidavit
templates.body: I solemnly affirm that my passport has been lost and despite all efforts it could not be recovered.

templates.title: Residence Affidavit
templates.body: I declare that I am residing at the stated address and the information provided is true.

templates.title: Name Correction Affidavit
templates.body: I affirm that both names belong to one and the same person.
